description: One conversation plus what clients do to history: a retry of an earlier turn, an edited prompt (fork), and the client's own compaction (history rewritten from the start).

messages.content:
Soft rain on the roof /
the gutters hum their one note /
morning comes slowly

Snow without a sound /
the street forgets its own name /
footprints, then nothing
The snow one: the silence does more work.

branches.note: retry: the client resends an earlier turn unchanged
edited prompt: the user changed message 3, forking the conversation

messages.content:
Wind turns every page /
of a book left on the sill /
no one reads it twice

branches.note: client compaction: everything before replaced by a summary

messages.content: Summary so far: the user asked for haiku about rain and snow and preferred the snow one.
